The Neighbourhood Transport Environment Typology (NTET) will provide a common evidence base for transport planning, regeneration, climate policy, and public health interventions across the city. NTET is a city-wide classification of neighbourhoods, similar to [Acorn](https://acorn.caci.co.uk/) or [Mosaic](https://www.experian.co.uk/business/platforms/mosaic), but focused on transport. It provides a common framework used to compare similar places, target interventions, benchmark outcomes, and support future analytical models. The current version of NTET uses only publicly available data (plus some OS data under via the Public Sector Geospatial Agreement).
